'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Insurgency in Northern Chad]]
**The government of [[Chad]] and more than 30 rebel and opposition factions sign a peace agreement at talks in [[Doha]], [[Qatar]]. However, the main rebel group [[Front for Change and Concord in Chad]] rejects the agreement, saying that negotiators had not listened to their demands, which included the release of [[political prisoner]]s. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/chad-rebels-sign-peace-deal-2022-08-08/ (Reuters)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[List of military aid to Ukraine during the Russo-Ukrainian War|Foreign aid to Ukraine during the Russo-Ukrainian War]]
**[[The Pentagon]] announces that it will send [[Ukraine]] an additional [[United States dollar|$]]1 billion in military assistance, including tens of thousands more munitions and explosives, the largest such aid package to the country since the start of the [[2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine|invasion]]. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/national-security/2022/08/08/new-ukraine-military-package-is-largest-yet-pentagon-says/ (''The Washington Post'')]

'''International relations'''
*[[Russia–United States relations]]
**[[Russia]] suspends [[New START]] arms inspections of its [[nuclear weapon]]s in response to travel restrictions imposed by the [[United States]] and its allies. [https://www.reuters.com/world/russia-tells-us-it-is-suspending-inspections-under-start-weapons-treaty-2022-08-08/ (Reuters)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[FBI search of Mar-a-Lago]]
**The [[Federal Bureau of Investigation]] executes a [[search warrant]] at [[Mar-a-Lago]], the primary residence of former [[President of the United States|U.S. president]] [[Donald Trump]], as part of a [[United States Department of Justice|Justice Department]] investigation into Trump. [https://edition.cnn.com/2022/08/08/politics/mar-a-lago-search-warrant-fbi-donald-trump/index.html (CNN)]
